Refresh

What Refresh sells

  • Computer-use software worlds: Realistic, connected applications for business tasks, including electronic health records.
  • BlenderBench: Expert-built tasks for modeling and animation, including rigging and materials. Also covers physics simulation, with versioned checks of results.
  • computer-1: A tool for testing computer use across models, contributed to Harbor.
  • Trajectories: Step-by-step records of agent actions, with benchmark results.
